fbdacc6e4b.q: What aging in place technologies does Easy Living use for fall detection and monitoring?
fbdacc6e4b.a: Easy Living works with PontoSense, which uses motion-based sensor technology similar to backup car sensors without requiring audio or video recording. The system tracks if seniors haven't left their bathroom or bedroom for extended periods and can detect falls. Chamberlain also mentioned Wisdom.io as another remote monitoring solution, noting that traditional wearable fall detection systems fail because seniors don't consistently wear them and may fall on the device itself.
